title: Move skills/bee-hive/templates -> packages/bee + full path-reference sweep + manifest payload role
action: Per D1/D2/D3 + validation repairs (see report). `git mv skills/bee-hive/templates packages/bee`, then fix-forward IN THIS ORDER: (1) onboard_bee.mjs — 3 ESM imports :65-67 -> ../../../packages/bee/lib/*; TEMPLATES_DIR block :85-89 -> path.join(PLUGIN_ROOT,'packages','bee') derivatives (PLUGIN_ROOT :90 unchanged); tuple literal :493 -> packages/bee/lib/state.mjs; sweep ALL remaining refs in the file. test_onboard_bee.mjs: >=34 matching lines AND makeFakeSkillsRoot fixture must now also create packages/bee/lib/state.mjs OUTSIDE the fake skills tree (structural change, not string swap — read :68-80 comment). test_split_brain_regression.mjs >=7 refs. (2) scripts/ static importers (would crash regen otherwise): render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs:31, okf_instructions_fence.mjs:129 + fixture writes :527-528, okf_specs_fence.mjs 2 imports, census_stale_spawn_syntax.mjs, release-tuple.mjs 2 refs, test-fixture.mjs 3 refs. (3) Moved tree internal sweep: EVERY '../../../../' in packages/bee/** becomes '../../../' (39 specifiers across 27+ files incl test_msn_invariants:98 path.resolve, test_decisions_propagation:1179 new URL, test_guards_tokenizer:20 .bee/bin import, test_cells:2710, test_cli_state:53,930); plus internal literals in lib/{integration-queue,lease-store,workflow-store,workspace-store}.mjs and tests/{test_bee_cli,test_cells,test_claims,test_misc,test_msn_invariants,test_state}.mjs; guards.mjs regex :1454 /(^|\/)(?:bin\/lib|templates\/lib)(\/|$)/ -> replace templates\/lib segment with packages\/bee\/lib (bin/lib MUST stay — .bee/bin mirror), message string :1498. (4) scripts/tests sweep — every suite with live path resolution: test_verify_manifest, test_gate_bypass_doctrine, test_lib_mirror, test_compact_capsule, test_agents_budget:17, test_dispatch_prepare:22-23, test_native_probe:28,38, test_skill_render:23,28+fixture:201-206, test_compaction_module:50,57, test_compaction_advisories:62-63, test_compact_verbs:27, test_doctrine_parity:342,345, test_installers_e2e:352 (required-roots list: ADD 'packages', keep 'hooks' until cell 2), test_conformance, test_state_write_concurrency, test_store_lock, test_worktree_holds_race, test_worktree_merge_queue — acceptance is rg-clean, not a checklist: `rg -l 'skills/bee-hive/templates' scripts/ skills/` must return empty. (5) run_verify.mjs DISCOVERY_ROOTS 'skills/bee-hive/templates/tests' -> 'packages/bee/tests' ('hooks' entry untouched — cell 2). (6) install.ps1:317 sparse-checkout set: ADD 'packages' (keep 'hooks' — cell 2 drops it). (7) windows.yml templates refs: BEE_VERIFY_ROOT_FILTER :105 -> packages/bee/tests + suite path list :107-110 (hooks comments stay — cell 2). (8) D5 moved here per validation C5: release_manifest.mjs add enumerateTree(path.join(REPO_ROOT,'packages','bee'), 'package_payload') EXCLUDING the hooks/ subtree (dedicated plugin_hook walk stays at :133, repointed in cell 2); fix stale source_lib doc comment :5; plugin_distribution.mjs PACKAGE_ROLES :23-30 add 'package_payload'. (9) Impact registry: node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write (flag exists, :485 — no conditional). (10) REGEN OBLIGATION in this order: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs (stale .claude-plugin/.codex-plugin templates subtrees: 78+78 tracked files — regen removes from disk; git rm -r --cached any leftovers so the commit carries the deletions), then node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, then node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write.
